about: Moment id -> Internet Archive copy. 'item' is the archive.org item page, 'video', 'cover' and 'card' (the card image) are direct file links. Videos are the copies served by NHL Breakaway's media server (re-encoded, so their bytes differ from the IPFS originals; 'copy' says 'original' only when the sha256 matches the official value). Covers are the original files. Each item also has manifest.csv / manifest.json with the sha256 of every file. Moments missing here are not on the Archive yet.
